description: Staple Lab toolkit for building and maintaining production design systems and frontends

plugins.name: design-system
plugins.description: Interview-driven design system builder for React. Picks your primitive layer (Base UI / Radix / React Aria), component layer (shadcn, MUI, Mantine...), CSS system (Tailwind v4, CSS Modules, StyleX, vanilla-extract, Panda) and motion library (Motion, GSAP), then scaffolds DTCG design tokens, themed components, a searchable component inventory site, behavioural + a11y tests, token-enforcement lint rules, and optional npm packaging — all driven by one machine-readable registry that both humans and AI agents consume.
